no_additional_findings: No confirmed credential value leakage in the reviewed output paths: native API tokens remain in request headers; proxy traces omit headers/bodies; task-token files are removed, settings process log redacts its token. This is source review, not a credential audit of unrelated directories.

Simulator runner creates a fresh task simulator and only shuts down/deletes that returned UDID; it does not target a booted user simulator. Native drivers stop their own Popen handles and use isolated runtime homes.

Performance comparisons archive explicit resolved local commit IDs and hash archives/input files; shared node_modules is deliberate. Warmups are excluded and three alternating measured runs are reported. Scope correctly says headless Chromium rig/stage, not WKWebView/end-to-end; 60second soak is not a long-term leak conclusion.
MAINTAINERS-MAP.md settings ownership is host preset_service/runtime; corrected ARCHITECTURE now agrees.
limits: No native UI, no simulator launch, no new full XCTest run and no performance measurement occurred in this review. Existing actual XCTest logs were parsed read-only.

The native preset script still verifies final host/preset state rather than every failure/retry sentence; newer-choice lacks a final selected-preset UI assertion. Do not claim this exceeds its stated backend-recovery evidence scope.

sourceSha with dirtyTree=true identifies the base checkout plus a declared dirty worktree, not a clean release commit. Parent evidence-index/release gates must keep build/test/release identities distinct.
